correctness.rationale: For all \(D,\kappa>0\) and \(|\theta_0|<\pi/2\), independently derive the backward transform \(F=\cosh(uz)/\cosh z\). Conditional-time identities give the exact difference \(H/[\kappa(1-F)]\), whose denominator is positive. The comparison function has positive value at \(u=0\), negative values near \(u=1\), and derivative sign controlled by a strictly decreasing function \(Q(w)\), hence exactly one interior zero. Taylor expansion and endpoint scaling give \(u_c(0+)=1/\sqrt5\), correction \(8\sqrt5 z^2/1875\), and \(z[1-u_c(z)]\to w_*\), with a uniquely positive convex-equation root. Independent exit-time moment recursion reproduces the low-rate threshold. The actual checker.py file was executed and passed; finite checks are supporting only.

value.rationale: The conditional time ordering resolves whether reactive loss or re-entry is temporally faster among trajectories realizing each terminal event. It is a complete, sharp phase boundary for the natural single-wall episode for every rate and starting orientation, with a nontrivial single-crossing proof, a universal \(\mathrm{CV}=1\) weak-killing point and high-rate angular boundary-layer constant. This structural classification advances beyond plots or mere evaluation of the source MFPT formulas; it does not claim whole-channel or generalized hazard results.
